metricSources.use: dated totals and acceptance paths prior to the last partial UTC day

definitions.firstTry: Current Metrics 5.1 by receipt ID. First-try and reused-after-race over classified ordinary accepts. Unclassified includes compensating receipts.
definitions.receiptCheckLinks: Each distinct visible run contributes one unit total, split evenly among receipts that name it. Counts linked runs, including closed admission and attempt bindings. Earlier rejected operations and audit runs are outside this measure. Capped histories are partial.
definitions.acceptedRunnerMinutes: Known receipt accepted runner stamps. Equal accepting stamps for the same batch and commit share one cost. Coverage is per receipt.
definitions.discardedRunnerMinutes: Known receipt discarded runner stamps. No reliable execution-ID allocation for shared discarded runs. From landed submissions only. Missing, pending and unreported accounting may change coverage.
definitions.linkedRedAuditCount: Distinct following-audit run IDs ever labelled failed, culprit, in-red-range or made-tests-run within the retained receipt cohort. Assigned to earliest associated acceptance, which may precede audit. Includes subsequently flake-cleared runs. Incomplete coverage.
definitions.mainCheckFailuresInAuditExport: Metrics B red events by audit timestamp from the bounded newest-100 audit projection. An observed zero lacks historical completeness.
definitions.requestToEndCheckMinutes: Metrics 5.6 request-to-end sum, not test execution wall time; completed duration gap and all-start count retained separately.
definitions.windows: Reported pins and uniformly recomputed receipts are retained separately. Submit-to-commit percentiles linearly interpolate (n-1)p.
